title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
key_facts: Figma announced Figma Specs, a markdown editor for defining a company's design language, at its first Config event in India.
Specs can serve as a reference for teams and AI agents designing in Figma, and can link to canvas elements, FigJam diagrams, code layers and designs.
Teams can add design libraries, code libraries and guidelines so agents follow brand rules.
The code layers feature, in private beta since June, moves to public beta.
Figma now supports over 20 new tools through its MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI tools), including Open Code, Dia, Grok Bot and Sarvam.
Figma is integrating the Payload headless content management system, which it acquired last year, with Figma Make.
India is Figma's biggest user market outside the United States; the platform works with 40% of the top 100 companies on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
quote_evidence: Through some of these features, the company aims to provide a definition for its own and third-party agents to adhere to a brand's design rules better while creating with AI.
In the past week, the company made its agent on canvas available to a wider user base.
why_it_matters_hint: Figma is giving AI agents a written rulebook so their design output stays on-brand and more predictable.
notes: Company announcements reported by one outlet.
